svg.title: Research interests: nested and overlapping fields
svg.desc: The names of the five fields follow their outer boundaries. Classical field theory contains transport equations and hydrodynamics. Nonlinear waves occupy its overlap with dynamical systems; symmetry breaking occupies its overlap with statistical physics. Dynamical systems contains low-dimensional models, bifurcations and instabilities, and coupled oscillators containing synchronisation. Statistical physics contains kinetic theory, non-equilibrium statistical physics, and phase transitions and collective order. Condensed matter contains solid-state quantum plasmas, containing electron hydrodynamics, and soft matter, containing active matter. Microswimmers belong to active matter and overlap biophysics. Short links connect synchronisation, collective order and microswimmers; non-equilibrium physics and active matter; kinetic theory, transport and plasmas; and hydrodynamics and nonlinear waves.
